reason: I mostly run on the gym treadmill after work, so an app built around GPS routes and starting outdoors together with a crew doesn't match how I actually run right now. Collecting points to fix up virtual shoes feels like a game, not the thing that will get me back to running.
objection: Running GPS in the background will drain my battery, and indoors on a treadmill the GPS distance won't be accurate anyway. I also don't have a crew to start runs with.
would_change_my_mind: A proper treadmill/indoor mode that records my gym runs accurately without GPS, or a friend inviting me into their crew so I have people to run with.
